ai_review.summary: Energetic LSD‑charged performance with a standout version of The Eleven; recording quality is unclear but listeners find it enjoyable.
ai_review.review: Fans rave about the high‑energy vibe of this show – calling out the “LSD energy,” the meeting of the Dead with Captain Beefheart, and especially a superb rendition of The Eleven. While reviewers don’t discuss the technical side much, the overall impression is that the tape sounds fine enough to enjoy the jam‑heavy set.

ai_rating.rationale: Average rating of 4.2 stars from five reviews, with mostly positive comments about the performance and no major complaints about sound quality.

recording_quality.technical_notes: No reviewer mentions specific audio issues; overall impression is that the recording is listenable despite lack of detail on clarity or mix.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Jam‑heavy, experimental set with a psychedelic atmosphere; noted influences from Captain Beefheart and extended improvisations.
